Structural checks of the fishery truth and of observed data sets

Source: R/fishery_diagnostics.R
check_fishery_truth.Rd

check_fishery_truth() stops if any structural property of the true fishery data is violated (non-negative catches, ranges of hooks and HBF, identifier hierarchy, cells and coordinates from the biomass truth, regional access of each fleet, vessel active in the year of the set, identity EC = q x Hooks x D). check_observed_dataset() checks an observed data set.

Usage

check_fishery_truth(td, truth, vessels, cfg, verbose = TRUE)

check_observed_dataset(obs, cfg, name = "", truth = NULL)

Arguments

td

True fishery data.

truth

Population truth (fishery_truth()).

vessels

Vessel table of the om_fishery object.

cfg

Fishery configuration.

verbose

Print a message when all checks pass.

obs

Observed data set.

name

Name of the data set (messages).

Value

Invisible TRUE.
